name: Pill
description: Interactive filter and sort chips for lightweight view controls.

Pill.description: A single interactive chip. Use it to change a filter, sort, or lightweight view mode.

active.description: Marks the chip as selected and sets aria-pressed.

variant.description: Inactive neutral surface treatment. Colored tones keep their own soft surface.

tone.description: Closed token color tone for the whole pill. Use this for normal semantic colors before reaching for custom classes.

size.description: Visual density. All sizes keep at least a 44px touch target.

count.description: Optional compact count rendered after the label.

indicator.description: Optional token-based dot indicator. Do not pass custom colors.

indicatorPosition.description: Where the optional indicator dot appears.

activeClassName.description: Optional color/style override applied only when active. Use for app-specific category colors that are not covered by tone.

inactiveClassName.description: Optional color/style override applied only when inactive. Pair with activeClassName for app-specific category colors.

render.description: Base UI render prop for polymorphic targets. Prefer the default button for filters.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only; do not restyle selected state ad hoc.

behavior.description: Wrap onto multiple rows or keep a single horizontally scrollable row.

bleed.description: Lets a scroll row align to mobile viewport edges. Use only when the surrounding layout needs it.

forbidden: Do not use Pill for static status metadata; use Badge.
Do not use Pill as a main content section switch; use Tabs.
Do not use Pill for form-only segmented choice; use ToggleGroup once available.
Do not use activeClassName/inactiveClassName for one-off decoration; reserve them for repeated app-specific category colors.
Do not pass custom indicator colors; indicator remains token-based even when the Pill surface is custom-colored.
Do not put long labels in horizontally scrolling pill groups.

responsive.note: Every Pill size preserves at least a 44px touch target. Use PillGroup behavior="scroll" for chip sets that cannot wrap cleanly on mobile.
